name: Garlic Butter Herb Paste
base_and_flavor: Melted butter (or olive oil) + minced garlic + dried oregano + thyme + salt & black pepper.
why_it_works: Butter penetrates the protein surface, creating a crisp exterior while sealing in natural juices.

name: Classic Indian Tandoori Marinade
base_and_flavor: Thick yogurt (hung curd/Greek yogurt) + mustard oil + ginger-garlic paste + kashmiri red chili powder + garam masala + kasuri methi + lemon juice.
why_it_works: Yogurt acts as a thermal shield, locking moisture inside both chicken and paneer.

name: Honey Soy Garlic Glaze
base_and_flavor: Soy sauce + olive oil + honey + minced garlic + grated ginger + dash of sesame oil.
why_it_works: The honey caramelizes rapidly on the edges, while soy sauce caramelization builds a savory crust.

name: Creamy Chipotle Lime
base_and_flavor: Mayonnaise or Greek yogurt + chipotle chili powder (or smoked paprika) + garlic powder + lime juice + pinch of cumin.
why_it_works: Mayo is an emulsion of oil and egg yolk; air frying it leaves a rich, moist layer without tasting greasy.

name: Spicy Peanut Satay
base_and_flavor: Smooth peanut butter + soy sauce + warm water (to thin) + chili oil/sriracha + lime juice + garlic powder.
why_it_works: Fats in peanut butter melt over the protein, creating a thick, rich coating that prevents drying out.

name: Mediterranean Lemon Oregano
base_and_flavor: Extra virgin olive oil + fresh lemon juice + minced garlic + dried oregano + onion powder + salt.
why_it_works: Acid breaks down tough outer proteins while olive oil locks in juices.

name: Sesame Teriyaki Sticky Toss
base_and_flavor: Teriyaki sauce + neutral oil + sesame seeds + garlic powder + splash of rice vinegar.
why_it_works: High-sugar sauces brown quickly; toss with a little oil mid-way through cooking to avoid burning while staying juicy.

name: Green Peri Peri Punch
base_and_flavor: Store-bought or homemade Peri Peri seasoning + olive oil + splash of vinegar or lemon juice + minced cilantro/coriander.
why_it_works: Acid plus oil provides a sharp flavor hit while creating a zesty protective layer.

name: Pesto Mayo Crust
base_and_flavor: Prepared basil pesto + mayonnaise (1:1 ratio) + cracked black pepper.
why_it_works: Pesto's olive oil and pine nut fats combine with mayo to give a crunchy green crust over juicy meat or paneer.

name: Sweet Thai Chili Sesame
base_and_flavor: Sweet chili sauce + soy sauce + neutral oil + toasted sesame oil + pinch of red pepper flakes.
why_it_works: Forms a glossy sticky glaze that seals in moisture as air circulates.
